## Task

Add `CHANGELOG.md` following Keep a Changelog, with an initial `0.1.0` entry summarising current features, and a short "Releasing" section in `CONTRIBUTING.md` (bump version, update changelog, tag `vX.Y.Z`).

## Acceptance criteria

- Changelog covers the existing feature set at a high level.
- CONTRIBUTING explains when contributors should add an entry.
